task: Aegis pilot evidence bundle: ten-year independent verifiability (operator signatures in ledger, frozen format spec, test vectors)
prompt: Read src/aegis/pilot/{crypto,evidence-ledger,kill-authority,decision-authority,bundle,identity}.ts and docs/field-notes/2026-10-01-boardy-claims-audit.md rows 36-38 first. Goal: an auditor in ten years can verify every stop and decision from the export bundle alone, with any language, without Lifetime code. (1) In kill-authority.ts the 'human.override' ledger event must carry the operator's signed command: add detail.operator_credential_id, detail.command (the signed body without signature) and detail.operator_signature (base64url Ed25519 over canonicalJSON(body)). Do the same in decision-authority.ts for 'human.decide'. Keep existing fields; never write private keys. (2) bundle.ts: verifyBundle must re-verify each operator signature against credentials/<id>.json subjectPublicKeyPem and the credential's site signature; fail with a named failure when missing or invalid. Keep the kill/ exclusion. (3) Write docs/aegis/EVIDENCE_FORMAT_v1.md: frozen spec — UTF-8, one JSON object per line, LF; canonical JSON = recursively sorted keys by UTF-16 code units, no whitespace, undefined dropped, strings/numbers as ECMAScript JSON.stringify (state whether this equals RFC 8785 JCS and where it differs); event_hash = hex(sha256(prev_hash + canonical_event_json)) with exact field list; signature encoding; seal and manifest formats; which public keys a verifier needs (site key from site/site.json, operator keys and roles from credentials/*.json). (4) Test vectors under docs/aegis/evidence-test-vectors/: fixed test-only site and operator key pairs (labelled), a 6-event ledger with one human.override and one human.decide, a seal, a manifest, and expected.json listing every canonical string, event_hash and signature; generated deterministically by scripts/aegis-evidence-test-vectors.mjs. (5) Independent reference verifier tools/aegis-verify-py/verify.py (Python stdlib + 'cryptography' for Ed25519) that verifies the test-vector bundle and a real export bundle. (6) src/__tests__/aegis-evidence-vectors.test.ts: TS verifier reproduces expected.json byte-for-byte and rejects a one-byte change. No new npm dependency. (7) Binding (Copilot review #2321, high): a valid operator signature is not enough. Both verifiers (TS verify-bundle and Python) MUST prove that the signed command matches the ledger event it is attached to: every command field (command_id, target, reason, verdict, recommendation seq + event_hash, modified-recommendation hash, issuedAt/occurredAt) equals the corresponding event field; the command's operatorCredentialId equals detail.operator_credential_id; the credential's subjectId equals event.operator_id; the credential's role equals decision_by on human.decide; the credential itself verifies under the site key. Add negative test vectors where the site key re-signs a ledger whose event fields differ from the operator-signed command (changed target, changed verdict, changed reason, swapped credential) and assert both verifiers reject each with a named failure.
